batches.notes: Inspected full inset, labelled overview and all 58 individual 130x120 source crops enlarged 2x with canonical outlines. IDs and corners reconciled exactly against add8fb4. Findings concern the full outlined cell, not everything in its rectangular crop. Compared TEC symbols and existing model surveys after visual inspection. No detector status promoted to review. Agent review only; no historical absence, operational permission, capacity, seam identity or human adjudication inferred.
